sections.label: Singapore Muslim Identity project
sections.summary: MUIS launched the Singapore Muslim Identity project in 2004, and its Fatwa Committee may issue fatwa or guidance on errant practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Prof Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In 2004, MUIS launched the Singapore Muslim Identity (SMI) project to articulate the desired characteristics of Muslim religious life in Singapore's multiracial and multi-religious context.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Prof Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: SMI recognises that the understanding and practice of Islam can and has always been diverse, so long as it remains rooted to a valid tradition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Prof Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: However, if the practices and ideologies of any group are found to be fundamentally errant, MUIS, through its Fatwa Committee, would issue a fatwa or a guidance to pronounce what it finds objectionable and provide guidance to the Muslim community.

sections.label: Religious Rehabilitation Group efforts
sections.summary: The Religious Rehabilitation Group works to safeguard the community against radicalisation and recently launched a resource centre and hotline.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Prof Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Prominent among the efforts to safeguard our community against radicalisation is the Religious Rehabilitation Group (RRG).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Prof Yaacob Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The RRG also recently launched a resource centre and a hotline for members of the community to seek clarifications and advice on relevant queries.

sections.label: Registered religious teachers list
sections.summary: Over 1,600 teachers have registered, and the community is encouraged to select teachers from the ARS list on the MUIS website.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: If my memory serves me right, over 1,600 teachers have registered.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: What we would like to encourage is for members of our community to refer to that list, which is available on the MUIS website, for them to find the appropriate religious teachers for their classes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: The most important thing is that they select the teachers from the ARS.

sections.label: Increasing list publicity
sections.summary: More can be done to increase publicity, and ways to enhance usage of the list will be studied.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We can do more to increase the publicity.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Yaacob Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will certainly study the ways in which we can enhance the usage of the list.
